PHONICS ADVENTURES

Twenty-four draw-on-the-picture sound games.

Hear a sound from a grown-up, then find its pictures, rhyme, blend, swap and count — twenty-four phonics adventures made from our own storybook artwork, drawn on straight away with the pencil case. No scores, no timers, nothing to install.

This way to Class 28 →The class that goes with these adventures: Phonics & Beginning Sounds.
1 Cleared! Sound DetectiveSay the sound, then circle every picture that starts with it.Beginning sounds Play → 2 Cleared! Treasure Chest SoundsSay each word, then draw a line to the chest with the same first sound.Sound sorting Play → 3 Cleared! Rhyming Frog HopDraw a line from each picture to the picture that rhymes with it.Rhyming Play → 4 Cleared! Robot Sound BlenderWrite the letters, then read the word like a robot: c…a…t…Blending Play → 5 Cleared! Kangaroo Sound JumpsColor one circle for every sound in each word.Sound counting (phonemes) Play → 11 Cleared! Muffin Middle SoundsThe middle vowel is missing from every muffin word! Write the vowel that fits.Middle vowel sounds Play → 12 Cleared! Owl’s Sound Sorting LibraryDraw a line from each card to its sound shelf.Sound sorting Play → 13 Cleared! Penguin Syllable DrumsDrum the beats inside words: color a drum for every syllable you hear.Syllables Play → 14 Cleared! Raccoon’s Odd Sound HuntTwo words start the same, one is the odd raccoon. Circle the impostor!Comparing sounds Play → 15 Cleared! Submarine Sound ScannerScan each word: circle FIRST or LAST — where do you hear the sound?Sound position Play → 16 Cleared! Bunny Word Family VillageRead each word, then draw a line to the house where it lives.Word families Play → 17 Cleared! Sloth’s Blending SlideWrite the rest of each s-word and slide the sounds together.Blending with support Play → 18 Cleared! Unicorn Sound SwapSwap the first sound and write the new word.Sound manipulation Play → 19 Cleared! Dinosaur Sound TrainWrite each word in its train cars, one sound per car.Blending and writing Play → 20 Cleared! Monkey’s Missing MiddleThe monkey dropped the middle of every word! Write the missing vowel.Middle vowels Play → 21 Cleared! Firefly Sound CountingColor one firefly circle for every SOUND in each word.Phoneme counting Play → 22 Cleared! Polar Bear Word BuilderThe words froze solid! Write the letters to thaw them out, sound by sound.Word building Play → 23 Cleared! Mermaid’s Sound SwitchSwitch the last sound and write the new word.Ending sound manipulation Play → 24 Cleared! Every card is one draw-on-the-picture adventure. Progress is saved on this device for the child chosen in My Classroom.

FOR GROWN-UPS

What each game practises.

The twenty-four adventures climb one slope: hearing first sounds (Sound Detective, Elephant’s Bubbles, the Dragon’s path), sorting and comparing them (Treasure Chests, the Owl’s library, Raccoon’s odd hunt), rhyming (Frog Hop, Ice Cream Shop), blending sounds into words (Robot Blender, Sloth’s Slide, Dinosaur Train, Polar Bear Builder), locating sounds in words (Crocodile’s endings, Submarine’s positions, Muffin’s and Monkey’s middle vowels), counting sounds and syllables (Kangaroo, Firefly, Penguin), and finally swapping sounds to make new words (Unicorn, Mermaid, Bunny’s word families).

Say the sounds with your child — a clean “sss”, a humming “mmm” — and let the recordings do the rest. Every worksheet twin prints without audio and tells you exactly what to say.

The adventures belong to Class 28 — Phonics & Beginning Sounds and live beside the other Age 4 collections: Shape Adventures, Colors & Creativity and Writing Adventures.

PLAY · BEGINNING SOUNDS

Sound Detective

Look at the letter in the bubble, say its sound, then circle every picture that starts with it.

Drawing on the picture needs JavaScript. Everything else on this page works without it — and the matching worksheet brings this adventure to paper.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This activity trains beginning sounds right on the adventure picture, with one short written instruction a grown-up can read aloud. Nothing is graded and nothing is scored — the win is a child who picked up a pencil, played with the sounds they hear in words, and saved work they are proud of. Saying the sounds cleanly (sss, not “suh”) as they draw is exactly how reading research says to teach them.

Prefer paper? The Sound Detective worksheet brings the same activity to the kitchen table with a parent-read sound script and an answer line — printing a worksheet never marks a class complete.

PLAY · MIDDLE VOWELS

Monkey’s Missing Middle

The monkey dropped the middle of every word! Write the missing vowel in each box.

Drawing on the picture needs JavaScript. Everything else on this page works without it — and the matching worksheet brings this adventure to paper.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This activity trains middle vowels right on the adventure picture, with one short written instruction a grown-up can read aloud. Nothing is graded and nothing is scored — the win is a child who picked up a pencil, played with the sounds they hear in words, and saved work they are proud of. Saying the sounds cleanly (sss, not “suh”) as they draw is exactly how reading research says to teach them.

Prefer paper? The Monkey’s Missing Middle worksheet brings the same activity to the kitchen table with a parent-read sound script and an answer line — printing a worksheet never marks a class complete.
